deep_dive.title: FutureWorld: A Plug-and-Play Causal Next-State Predictor for Interactive Video World Exploration
deep_dive.abstract: Interactive video world models aim to follow user actions while maintaining scene consistency over extended interactions. History-based methods reuse generated latents to preserve scene content, but three limitations of this reuse contribute to error recirculation. 1) The latent generated at each interaction is retained as history, potentially containing blurred details, geometric distortions, or semantic drift. 2) Although retrieved historical content matches the current scene, it can still contain errors that are carried into the next chunk. 3) New outputs then become history for later interactions, potentially reinforcing the same errors through repeated reuse. To limit this cycle, we aim to predict the future scene state from the current generated latent and the next action before generating the next interaction's video chunk. This future-state prior provides guidance for the next chunk, with the aim of reducing the errors carried forward from history. To this end, we propose a plug-and-play Causal Next-Chunk Predictor (C-NCP) with cross-model adaptability and prediction-guided modulation. We integrate C-NCP into four base generators and evaluate the augmented models across three benchmarks for interactive long-video generation and action-conditioned world modeling. Extensive experiments demonstrate reduced error accumulation and improved long-horizon consistency across diverse generation settings. The project page is at https://GuangYuanKK.github.io/futureworld.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Interactive video world models suffer error recirculation from reusing generated latents as history. FutureWorld introduces a plug-and-play causal next-state predictor to forecast future scene state and limit error accumulation during extended interactions.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 交互式视频世界模型需在长程交互中遵循用户动作并保持场景一致，但基于历史潜变量的复用会导致模糊、几何畸变与语义漂移等误差循环累积。作者提出FutureWorld，一个即插即用的因果下一状态预测器，用于预测未来场景状态以抑制误差回传。该工作针对交互式世界模型的可控性与一致性提出明确方法，对持久交互世界构建具有直接价值。
